address.lineWithUnit: 22 Dr Martin Luther King Drive Unit B1

remarks: Recently renovated 1 Bedroom Condo in beautiful SoNo. Desirable ground floor, level entry, end unit with newer stainless appliances and washer/dryer in unit. Rear stone patio provides outdoor entertaining possibilities with a wooded view. Turn key, move in ready.  Just a quick walk to the movies, grocery store, the SoNo Collection and Norwalk Aquarium. Easy access to I-95 and public transportation.  One assigned parking spot included.
